title.html:
An idea.
A few first questions.

faq.q: Do I need a finished design?

a.html: No. A photograph of the setting, moodboard, sketch or practical requirement can be enough to begin. Together, we clarify function, dimensions, materials and the next decisions.

faq.q: Can you develop a complete collection?

a.html: Yes. We consider the accessories together and coordinate materials, colours and finishes. The construction still follows the purpose of each individual item.

faq.q: What belongs in the first enquiry?

a.html: Tell us the application, accessory or idea, quantity and required delivery date. We welcome one-offs and very small runs, and can also deliver large projects. Reference photographs and dimensions help us agree the right specification and schedule with you.
